# Scale With Ads™

> Scale With Ads™ is a Meta ads agency that runs Facebook and Instagram campaigns for law firms and service businesses, including exclusive personal injury, MVA, mass tort and workers comp leads.

Founded and led by Vaishali Kapoor (Founder) and Gaurav Kapoor (Co-Founder). Website: https://www.scalewithads.us

Last updated: 26 November 2026. Company facts: https://www.scalewithads.us/about

## Team

- Vaishali Kapoor, Founder
- Gaurav Kapoor, Co-Founder (https://www.facebook.com/gaurav.kapoor.3994)
- Ali Jawed, Video Editor; Taqi Jafar, Graphic Designer; Syed Hassan Ali Shah, Web Developer

The team reports 12+ years in advertising and $50M+ in Meta ad spend managed.

## What we do

- Offer positioning and messaging strategy
- Meta (Facebook and Instagram) Ads management
- Ad creatives, short-form video ads, UGC and VSL scripting
- Sales funnels and landing pages
- CRM setup, AI follow-up automations, SMS and email sequences
- Lead qualification and calendar booking

Who it is for: agency owners, coaches, consultants, high-ticket service providers and B2B founders generating $10,000+/month. We focus on law firms (personal injury, MVA, mass tort and workers comp) and also work with marketing agencies, coaches, consultants, B2B services and e-commerce.

Clients own 100% of every asset we build. Onboarding and system build take roughly 14 to 21 days from kickoff to live campaigns.

## Lead generation offers

- [Exclusive MVA leads for personal injury attorneys](https://www.scalewithads.us/exclusive-mva-leads): car, truck and motorcycle accident leads from ads in the firm's own account, never shared; includes a cost-per-signed-case calculator
- [Facebook ads for lawyers](https://www.scalewithads.us/facebook-ads-for-lawyers): done-for-you Meta Ads for law firms; published results include 530 leads in 7 days for a Texas personal injury firm
- [Car accident leads](https://www.scalewithads.us/car-accident-leads): auto accident leads screened for fault, injury and representation
- [Workers comp leads](https://www.scalewithads.us/workers-comp-leads): injured-worker inquiries screened for work injury and claim status
- [Mass tort leads](https://www.scalewithads.us/mass-tort-leads): claimants screened against the firm's tort criteria (no mass tort results published yet)

## Key facts

- Who we serve: personal injury and other law firms in the United States, plus agencies that advertise for attorneys
- Case types: personal injury, motor vehicle accidents (car, truck, motorcycle, rideshare), workers compensation and mass tort
- Pricing model: the firm pays Meta directly for ad spend in its own ad account, plus a management fee scoped on the strategy call. Leads are not sold per lead and never shared
- Setup: campaigns typically go live 14 to 21 days after the kickoff call
- Compliance: the firm approves every ad and landing page against its state bar's advertising rules; ads never promise case outcomes

## Published legal results (Meta Ads, dated client dashboards on /work)

- 76 MVA leads in 5 days at $17.13 per lead ($1,301.63 spent, Jul 27 to Jul 31, 2026)
- 203 MVA leads in 21 days at $18.69 per lead ($3,793.86 spent, Jul 1 to Jul 21, 2026)
- 530 leads in 7 days at $26.93 per lead for a Texas personal injury firm ($14,270 spent, Jun 1 to Jun 7, 2026)
- No workers comp or mass tort results are published yet

## Frequently asked questions

- **Who is this for?** Our system is built specifically for agency owners, coaches, consultants, high-ticket service providers, and B2B founders already generating $10,000+/month looking to scale predictably.
- **Is this completely Done-For-You?** Yes, 100%. We handle offer positioning, copy, creative design, sales funnel build, Meta ads management, CRM setup, AI automations, and lead qualification.
- **Do I own everything?** Yes. Every single asset we build (funnels, copy, ad creatives, CRM sequences, and customer data) belongs 100% to your business with no lock-ins.
- **How long does implementation take?** Complete onboarding and system build takes roughly 14 to 21 days from our kickoff call to launching your live campaigns.
- **What industries do you work with?** We work across 30+ verticals including law firms (personal injury, MVA, mass tort and workers comp), digital marketing agencies, coaches and consultants, B2B services and e-commerce.
- **What happens on the strategy call?** We perform a audit of your current client acquisition bottlenecks, review your offer, and outline a customized 90-day growth roadmap for your business.
- **How is this different from a marketing agency?** Traditional agencies only run ads and hand off raw leads. We build a complete client acquisition ecosystem including qualification, CRM, AI follow-ups, and a 90-day written guarantee.
- **What's included?** Offer positioning, messaging strategy, Meta ads management, ad creatives, sales funnels, CRM setup, AI follow-up automations, SMS/email sequences, lead qualification, and calendar booking.
